composition_subtypes.role: Monotonic stack to compute next/prev smaller element indices
Stores value occurrences and prefix/suffix max indices for quick lookup

payload.core_composition_summary: Precompute next/prev smaller via monotonic stack and store prefix/suffix max indices in hash maps, then scan with binary search on these structures.
payload.rationale: Combines amortized O(n) stack for range boundaries and hash maps for O(1) index lists, with binary search to select valid partition points.
